create.name: Land of Joy
create.bio:
Land of Joy is a volunteer-run residential retreat centre of the FPMT, set in Greenhaugh Hall in the Northumberland National Park in north-east England. It was founded in 2010 under the guidance of Lama Zopa Rinpoche and held its first retreat in May 2015, after years of work buying and restoring the house, its outbuildings, walled garden and woodland. A renovated coach house now holds personal retreat rooms and a protector room, and three wooden huts in the woods above the valley serve longer solitary retreats.

The centre's year is built around group retreats, from introductory and non-Buddhist weekends to tantric practice, led by FPMT teachers. Practitioners can also come for personal retreats, including work on the preliminary practices, with meals supplied by the resident team, or stay in a hut for anything from one week to three months if they have an established practice. Neighbours are invited to a free evening meditation twice a month in the main gompa. Stays follow a generosity model in which guests choose what to give, and an online library gathers teachings and puja guidance.

courses.title: Individual/Personal Retreat
courses.description: A self-directed retreat in the centre's private rooms, following your own practice schedule in quiet grounds, with lunch and supper provided by the team on site. Guests choose what to give under the centre's generosity model.
courses.price: Generosity model (you choose what to give)

courses.title: Private Retreat Huts
courses.description: Three woodland huts for solitary retreats of one week to three months, without internet or phone. Applicants need a settled daily practice, a clear retreat plan and a teacher or senior student to support them.
courses.price: Generosity model (you choose what to give)

courses.title: Preliminary Practice Retreats
courses.description: Guidance and space for completing Tibetan Buddhist preliminaries, such as refuge or mandala offerings, in the huts or other retreat rooms, booked as a personal retreat.
courses.price: Generosity model (you choose what to give)

courses.title: Wednesday Night Meditation
courses.description: An evening group meditation in the main gompa for people living nearby, where experienced meditators introduce a range of methods. No booking is needed.

free_resources.title: Practice & Retreat Resource Library
free_resources.description: An online collection of videos, audio, texts and guidance from teachers connected with the centre, grouped by teacher and by theme, including puja and lam-rim resources.
